about: Salted SHA-256 hashes of the names on the PI site's commented-out ('hidden') roster cards that appear nowhere else (brief WP7 #6 as amended by the critic). Names are never stored in the repo. Hash = sha256(salt + ':' + normalized name); normalized = NFKD, diacritics removed, lower-case, letters only, single spaces. Variants per name: full name without a parenthetical nickname, first + last, and (if present) the form with the nickname and nickname + last. The scanner checks 2- to 4-word windows (2-word windows also reversed) in the raw text and in the text with parentheticals removed.
